summary: One step of an in-place pixel-format expansion. Reads the base-format byte at this+8 (0 or 2) and the bit-depth state byte at this+9 (8 or 16), expands the pixel buffer at a2 from the current byte-per-pixel width to the next one, then writes back the stride (this+11), bytes-per-pixel (this+10) and expanded count (this+4). Returns the new count.

local_names.a1: format state object: count at +0, count at +4, base format byte at +8, bit-depth state byte at +9, bytes-per-pixel at +10, stride at +11
local_names.a2: pixel buffer, expanded in place from the back toward the front
local_names.a3: packed color word (low byte plus byte-1) used to fill the expanded gaps
local_names.a4: sign flag selecting which fill pattern to write

operations.description: Read pixel count at this+0 and base-format byte at this+8: value 0 selects the 2-byte-family path, value 2 the 4-byte-family path; any other value returns the count unchanged.
Within base format 0, test the bit-depth state byte at this+9 equals 8 to select the 1-to-2-byte-per-pixel step; return unchanged when the state is neither 8 nor 16.

Base 0, state 8: expand in place from 1 to 2 bytes per pixel, walking the buffer backward and interleaving the source byte with the fill byte; then set bytes-per-pixel (this+10) to 2, stride (this+11) to 16, and double the count.

Base 0, state 16: expand in place from 2 to 4 bytes per pixel, spreading each source byte over 4 output bytes with color/alpha fill; then set bytes-per-pixel (this+10) to 2, stride (this+11) to 32, and quadruple the count.
Base 2, state 8: expand in place from 1 to 4 bytes per pixel; then set stride (this+11) to 32, bytes-per-pixel (this+10) to 4, and quadruple the count.
Base 2, state 16: expand in place from 4 to 8 bytes per pixel; then set stride (this+11) to 64, bytes-per-pixel (this+10) to 4, and octuple the count.
Write the expanded count to the dword at this+4.

clean_pseudocode: count = dword(a1, +0); base = byte(a1, +8); state = byte(a1, +9);
if (state == 8) { expand_1_to_2(a2, count, a3, a4); byte(a1,+10)=2; byte(a1,+11)=16; count *= 2; }
else if (state == 16) { expand_2_to_4(a2, count, a3, a4); byte(a1,+10)=2; byte(a1,+11)=32; count *= 4; }
if (state == 8) { expand_1_to_4(a2, count, a3, a4); byte(a1,+11)=32; byte(a1,+10)=4; count *= 4; }
else if (state == 16) { expand_4_to_8(a2, count, a3, a4); byte(a1,+11)=64; byte(a1,+10)=4; count *= 8; }
unresolved: Exact byte-interleave pattern of each expansion branch (which position receives the color word low byte vs byte-1) is not fully resolved from source:raw.
Whether the sign flag a4 selects a final tail-write variant is inferred, not confirmed.
Meaning of the base-format enum (0 vs 2) outside this state machine is unknown.
